name: Azure DevOps
description: Microsoft's Azure DevOps server, run locally for one organization: work items, repositories, pull requests, pipelines and wikis. The first tool call signs in with your Microsoft account. It needs Node.js.

probe.note: Invocation from the vendor's documentation, pinned to @azure-devops/mcp@2.11.0, the newest stable release published on 2026-11-11. The catalog never starts it unpinned.
